units.rawText: Working in the Oasis is a blessing. The mines in the real world are not so clean.

units.rawText: Dolls don't get black lung, but working in such terrible conditions still inflicts irreversible damage on us.

units.rawText: I was just a mineral sampler so I already had it easy. Those human miners... or even the mining Dolls... most of them don't live long enough to retire.
